{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Count total SEVERE patients
n_severe_total = len(severe_patients)

# Filter out sentinel values (-999)
severe_without_sentinel = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Count valid SEVERE patients after excluding -999
n_severe_valid = len(severe_without_sentinel)

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL)
mean_baseline_severe = severe_without_sentinel['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Total SEVERE patients: {n_severe_total}")
print(f"SEVERE patients with valid biomarker_baseline: {n_severe_valid}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL) among SEVERE patients (excluding -999): {mean_baseline_severe}")"}
